cohort: 2429 women who underwent THR in Finland from 1980 to 2007, compared to 7276 controls without THR
finding: Neonates born after maternal total hip replacement have an increased risk of stillbirth, preterm birth, small for gestational age, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Trial of labor was more likely to end in emergency cesarean section in the patient group than in the control group.
